reps_validation.reason: REPS bands have not yet been verified as individual ensemble members rather than mixed statistics.

deterministic_scenarios.impact: negligible or no material deterministic QPF

limitations: Only uncensored event peaks are used for point prediction; censored events widen upper bounds as lower-bound constraints.
Starkey timing is translated from 05EA002 using weakly correlated downstream timing and remains low confidence.
Exact Starkey water level is not predicted because no common site gauge datum exists.
REPS probabilities are withheld from operational use until GRIB band metadata verifies individual ensemble members.
Medium-range dry/central/wet paths are delay-based GEPS member scenarios, not deterministic hydraulic traces.

official_outlook.interpretation: HRDPS governs the first 48 hours. Actual GEPS members selected near the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles govern later rainfall windows through 16 days. Only windows beginning before the projected 1.70 m crossing are allowed to delay that crossing.

limitations: Only two uncensored historical peak-response events are available for point prediction.
No historical event has a completely observed recovery, so delay estimates remain weakly constrained.
GEPS supplies cumulative precipitation and broad timing windows; exact storm timing inside each window is unresolved.
The medium-range analogue uses a duration proxy capped at 72 hours and has no forecast spatial-coverage percentage feature.
Daily paths represent recession-clock delays at 05EA002, not a hydraulic simulation or exact Starkey stage.
